title: Unify routing decision telemetry across region/tier/fallback flows
creator: Emily Chen
description: Add a harmonized telemetry surface for routing decisions (region selection, tier routing, and fallback model variants) that balances fidelity, cost, and ease-of-use for debugging. Current decision logs are fragmented across services (router, policy engine, fallback coordinator), making RCA slow when cross-region fallbacks or tier escalations occur. This ticket standardizes an immutable routing-decision record, per-request hop summaries, and a compact enriched trace that is cheap to store and supports sampled full-context captures.
acceptance_criteria: Routing-decision record schema published and approved (confluence link).
All router components emit a single top-level routing_decision_id per request and include it in existing request traces and logs.
Per-hop summary metrics (chosen_region, chosen_tier, selected_model_variant, decision_latency_ms, decision_reason_code) are emitted to metrics pipeline with a configurable sampling rate.
Sampled full decision payloads (including policy inputs and fallback rationale) are captured and stored in object storage with retention policy; stored artifacts are linked by routing_decision_id.
Dashboard tile added to Console showing routing failure-rate by region/tier and average fallback frequency, with drilldown to sampled decision payloads.
End-to-end tests demonstrating that an intentional region outage triggers fallback flow and generates the expected telemetry records.
Documentation and migration notes for downstream consumers (logs team, SLO dashboards, incident playbooks).
implementation_notes: Introduce routing_decision_id UUID at the ingress proxy layer to guarantee request-level association.
Add lightweight per-hop envelope: {routing_decision_id, hop_index, chosen_region, chosen_tier, model_variant, reason_code, latency_ms} emitted as structured log and metrics.
Keep verbose policy inputs out of the hot path: full policy context is written to async object store when sampling flag is true; default sample rate 0.5%.
Use existing metrics exporter (prometheus -> metrics pipeline) for hop summaries; include labels for customer_id and route_hash to enable cost attribution.
Backward compatibility: components missing the new header must create a routing_decision_id and mark origin metadata to allow later merging.
tradeoffs_and_decisions: Verbosity vs cost: decided to emit compact per-hop summaries by default and capture full context only when sampled to keep storage costs manageable.
Sampling strategy: chose deterministic hashing + low fractional sampling to ensure reproducible captures for customer-driven investigations.
Retention: roll full captures to 90 days for paid customers and 14 days for free accounts; per-hop metrics retained per existing metrics retention policy.
Security: full captures may contain prompt/partial responses; we will redact PII using existing redaction pipeline before writing to object storage.
Trace correlation: prefer passing routing_decision_id as a trace tag instead of embedding large payloads into spans to avoid trace size bloat.
testing_plan: Unit tests for header propagation and routing_decision_id generation in proxy and router components.
Integration test that simulates region latency and verifies fallback model emitted correct per-hop docs and stored capture when sampled.
Load test to measure additional QPS overhead of emitting per-hop summaries at 100% and validate CPU impact < 2% on router pods.
E2E test exercising Console drilldown to a stored capture URI and verifying redaction layer applied.
Run experiment on 1% of traffic for two weeks, validate cost delta and signal quality of captured artifacts.
rollout_plan: Phase 1: library changes and schema doc; deploy to staging. (PR #5432)
Phase 2: enable per-hop emission at 100% but sampling for full captures at 0% in canary region (us-west-2) for 48h.
Phase 3: enable sampled full captures at 0.5% on 1% production traffic for two weeks and monitor cost and SLO impact.
Phase 4: iterate based on feedback; enable on all regions and add Console dashboard tile.
Rollback: disable per-hop emission at ingress proxy or set sample rate to 0% if errors or cost spike detected.
